purpose: Define external Portfolio evidence as an explicit reference with source identity, retrieval/provenance metadata and verification state rather than an automatically trusted claim.

topics.name: Portfolio External Reference Evidence
topics.purpose: Define external Portfolio evidence as an explicit reference with source identity, retrieval/provenance metadata and verification state rather than an automatically trusted claim.

semantics.source_rule: External source/issuer identity is explicit where resolvable.
semantics.locator_rule: URL/file/hash/registry locator is evidence location, not semantic identity by itself.
semantics.verification_rule: Verification result is explicit evidence and may expire/change.
semantics.trust_rule: Verified external reference does not automatically create MeritCore trust/points/Tier.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Where evidence must remain reproducible, snapshot/hash/provenance policy is explicit.

invariants.rule: PortfolioCore represents explicit identity-linked references and evidence metadata; it never manufactures competence, merit, trust or authorization from presentation content.

hard_gates.condition: external URL treated as semantic identity automatically
unverified evidence displayed as verified machine state

prose.summary: Define external Portfolio evidence as an explicit reference with source identity, retrieval/provenance metadata and verification state rather than an automatically trusted claim.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing PortfolioCore/IdentityCore/MeritCore contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
